What the workshop does

From the sign above the workshop and from what customers describe on Google.

Leather seat repair

Ten Google reviews mention leather seat repair. Customers write that worn seats look like new again, in one case after two hours, in another after a few hours.

Headlinings

Seven reviews mention headliner repair. A sagging roof lining was taken out and replaced in half a day for one customer and in less than a day for another.

New and custom seats

The sign names custom seats. One customer could feel and test a new seat several times while it was being built. Motorcycle seats are restyled in leather too.

Doors, carpets, soft tops

The sign lists door panels, repairs and restorations. Reviews add door upholstery, custom floor mats, a convertible roof and the complete interior of a 1991 off-roader.

From the workshop

Photos from the workshop’s own Facebook page and Google listing.

How a job works

Taken from what customers describe in their Google reviews.

Often done within a day

Reviews mention two hours for seats, a few hours for a leather repair, a same-day fix and one day for cushions.

Kept up to date

One customer writes that they were always kept up to date. Another praises the communication from the team, from first contact to the finished job.

Try it while it is made

For a new seat, one customer was allowed to feel and test it several times while it was being built.

One workshop, two names

On Google and Facebook the workshop at Alexandrou Panagouli 24 in Larnaca is listed as Extreme Trim. The new sign above the door and the Instagram account say V&J Car Interiors, established in 1998, with the line “Premium car upholstery”. One customer drove from Limassol for a leather repair. The reviews describe leather seats, headlinings, soft tops and bespoke interiors, including vintage cars.

What customers say

Three of 67 Google reviews, 4.9 stars on average.

Highly recommended, and thank you again!”
